origin.description: strwrap2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. wrap_always breaks inside a word.
origin.usage: strwrap2_sgr(x, width = 0.9 * getOption("width"), indent = 0, exdent = 0, prefix = "", simplify = TRUE, initial = prefix, wrap.always = FALSE, pad.end = "", strip.spaces = !tabs.as.spaces, tabs.as.spaces = getOption("fansi.tabs.as.spaces", FALSE), tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: strwrap2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. wrap_always breaks inside a word. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.
